title: During October, Treat a Friend to Nitro and Trick Out Your Profile for Halloween 🎃
summary: Do you embrace tricks in the Shop or turn them into treats? Trick out your profile with shockingly sweet decorations, or treat your friend to Nitro and earn something for yourself in return!
body:
Peer through the shroud of your Onyx client theme. A familiar Discord notification echoes from the distance, but it’s growing... louder... Some dark trickery this way comes. It’s getting closer, and it smells like… erm, candy corn? 

Do you embrace these treacherous tricks, or shift the tides and turn them into treats? This Halloween, you’ll be able to decide which side you go for. And once you’ve chosen your fate, you can show the world what you’ve done… or help pull them to your side.
